title: I was about to purchase the app, but a few basic functionalities are missing
body:
I really wanted to invest in this app, but there are some key features that are holding me back. The central dial should display the current task in progress along with a timer showing the remaining time. Additionally, the dial should move automatically to the next task without requiring manual intervention.

As it stands, I have to manually adjust the dial to keep up with the workflow, which disrupts the experience. This is particularly inconvenient on an iPad, where the app otherwise has great potential. I hope these issues are addressed in future updates.
author: AakashKhatri
